subject: Marketplace launch readiness: catalog copy + co-sell plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace launch readiness: catalog copy + co-sell plan

Team —

Attaching a first pass at the AWS offer page and a SKU/pricing matrix for the Acme PoC we discussed. AWS partner manager (Alice) asked us to confirm copy and confirm co-sell handoff timeline this week so we can hit their next submission window.

Asks:
- Vanessa: please review the product summary and 2-line elevator copy (offer_page_draft.md) — focus on enterprise benefit language and co-sell-friendly phrasing.
- Karthik: quick scan for any technical claims that might trigger extra legal review (latency/throughput numbers).
- Laura: confirm billing SKU mapping and whether the reserved capacity option needs separate SKUs.

Attachments: offer_page_draft.md, pricing_sku_matrix.csv, co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf

Proposed timeline:
- Today EOD: internal comments
- Tue 11/24: submit to AWS Partner Network (APN) intake
- Tue/Wed: follow up with Alice for co-sell enablement slots

Thanks — I want this to be lightweight but reviewer-ready. If you see anything that would block APN review, flag it now.

— Neha Kapoor
Sales Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0199

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch readiness: catalog copy + co-sell plan

Neha —

Thanks for kicking this off. Quick notes after a pass on offer_page_draft.md (inline comments in the doc and high level below):

- Hero/one-liner: prefer tightening the customer outcome — suggest "Predictable, production-grade LLM inference across hosted and private deployments" instead of the current phrasing.
- Use case bullets: remove the internal-facing phrasing ("platform-first teams") — replace with verticalized examples: "SaaS automation, customer support agents, and search ranking".
- Technical claims: flagging the "<10ms token latency" line — that currently reflects a best-case microbench; we should replace with a range or remove. (Karthik, see your callout.)
- Co-sell blurb: add a short paragraph oriented to AWS sellers: success criteria, top three differentiators, and an ask (joint demo + pricing alignment). I added a 3-bullet co-sell summary in the doc.

Attachments: I uploaded a cleaned copy to the Drive link and left comments in co-sell_playbook_v1.pdf (section 2).

Timeline: I can deliver a revised offer_page_draft.md by EOD if everyone else signs off on the proposed pitch changes.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Marketplace GTM, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch readiness: catalog copy + co-sell plan

Vanessa / Neha —

Thanks, good catch on the latency metric. A couple of quick comments from the product/legal side:

- Replace the specific SLA/latency numbers with qualitative language for the public copy: "optimized for low-latency inference on common sequence lengths". We can retain hard numbers in the technical spec attachment but not customer-facing marketplace copy.
- Technical categories: set the AWS category to "AI & ML > Inference" and add tags: "LLM inference, GPU-optimized, quantization" — that'll help search.
- Pricing: the CSV is mostly fine, but we need a clear label for "Reserved Capacity" vs "On-demand" SKUs — Laura, can you add SKU codes?

HubSpot: I linked the draft to DL-9082 and left a note for the partner motion so we track co-sell credits.

— Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@amazon.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch readiness: catalog copy + co-sell plan

Neha —

Appreciate the materials. A couple quick notes from APN intake:

- Please remove explicit latency numbers from the public offer description; AWS listing policy prefers outcome language unless backed by published benchmarks.
- Provide a separate technical spec (PDF) with the performance metrics you want to preserve for solution briefs.
- For co-sell enablement, we'll need: 1) a 1-page seller one-pager (targeted to AWS field sellers), 2) a joint customer proofing checklist, and 3) confirmation of an authorized joint demo environment.

I scheduled a 30-min intake sync with our marketplace team for Tue 11/24 at 10:30 PT. Please share the updated offer_page_draft.md and the seller one-pager before EOD Monday so we can preview before the sync.

DocuSign link for the APN co-sell acknowledgement: https://docusign.net/link/ABC123 (sign by 11/25).
